user.title: Add a Grab share link
user.description: Paste the full Grab share message (for example from WhatsApp or Telegram) or just the https://app.grab.com/s/... link.

error.no_share_url: No Grab share link was found in the message.
error.cannot_resolve: The Grab share link could not be resolved. Check the link and try again.
error.booking_details_failed: Grab did not return booking details for this link.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Grab share link is already set up.

set_share_message.name: Set share message
set_share_message.description: Replaces the Grab share message (or link) tracked by the targeted entries. Without a target, every entry is updated.
